properties.source: Appendix D to the West Northamptonshire Council Cabinet report of 19 November 2024 on Additional HMO Licensing. Two sheets, both carrying the identical polygon: s20317 (district sheet, 1:250,000) and s20318 (Northampton close-up, 1:75,000). Extracted from the 1:75,000 sheet.
properties.mapTitle: Additional Houses in Multiple Occupation Licensing Consultation

properties.method: The designated area is a single closed vector path (775 vertices, straight segments only) in the PDF content stream, not a raster. Georeferenced from the OS National Grid 1km graticule printed on the sheet: 21 vertical and 13 horizontal gridlines located to sub-pixel precision in the embedded basemap raster by comb correlation at the scale-implied period, then least-squares fitted (residual RMS 0.24px = 1.5m). Absolute grid values read from the printed two-digit labels (eastings 466-486, northings 254-266, OS 100km square SP). A constant calibration shift of dE=-2.00m, dN=+3.75m was then applied, derived by fitting the council boundary that the same PDF draws as a separate vector path against the official ONS Local Authority Districts December 2024 BFC boundary for E06000062.
properties.accuracy: After calibration the PDF's own drawn council boundary matches the official ONS boundary to a mean of 0.09m and a maximum of 0.31m across 797 independent vertices. Datum shift OSGB36->WGS84 via Inverse of British National Grid + OSGB36 to WGS 84 (9) + axis order change (2D) (stated accuracy 1.0m). Overall positional uncertainty is on the order of 1-2m, far finer than the street-level resolution needed.
properties.sanityChecks: 11/11 postcode in/out tests passed (Castle, Headlands, Hunsbury, Kingsley & Semilong, Upton, Blackthorn & Rectory Farm inside; Daventry town, Harpole/Kislingbury, Moulton, Towcester, Brackley outside). 99.99% of the polygon falls inside the council area (0.0095 km2 outside, boundary generalisation only). The identical polygon on the 1:250,000 district sheet matches by a pure scale factor with zero residual.
properties.caveat: IMPORTANT: the map is titled 'Proposed HMO Additional Licensing Consultation area' and dated 10-07-2024. It is the map at Appendix D that the Cabinet report and the formal decision minute of 19 November 2024 both identify as defining the designated area, but the sheet itself carries consultation wording. No street list has ever been published and no council address checker exists. Treat as authoritative for the designated area but confirm edge cases with the council.
properties.daventryNote: The council description 'additional areas in Northampton and Daventry' does NOT mean Daventry town, which is 13km outside the area. It refers to the western extension of the Northampton area into the former Daventry District (Upton, Duston fringe, towards Harpole and Kislingbury). The designation is one single contiguous polygon.
